photos.name: crumb-shot-and-loaf
photos.summary: Finished sourdough boule cut in half on a wire cooling rack. One half held up showing open, airy crumb with good hole distribution. The other half on the rack displays the crust with banneton ring pattern from no-linen proofing and a single score that bloomed well.

photos.name: toast-slice-night
photos.summary: Grilled cheese made with sourdough slices on a white plate — melted cheddar and tomato between golden-brown toasted sourdough. Late night lazy meal. Dog watching from behind the plate.
